name: K0maru Agent Memory
tagline: Executable Architectural Memory & Sub-10ms Living ADR Guard for AI Coding Agents
description: A Standalone, Single-Static-Binary (3.6 MB pure-Rust core), Zero-Daemon Long-Term Memory Hub and sub-10ms Living ADR Guard for AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, and Gemini CLI.
features: Sub-10ms in-memory Living ADR Guard evaluating K-DSL architectural invariants on git pre-commit and Claude Code Stop-hook (hooks.Stop)
Deterministic zero-LLM supersession (k0maru flush --supersedes) that auto-updates frontmatter lifecycle metadata and strips inbound WikiLink boosts to prevent belief entrenchment
Diff-aware bounded loadouts (<300 tokens) injecting minimal high-relevance architectural context without context-window pollution
Zero background daemon, zero open network ports, 3.4ms cold start, disposable cache (rebuilds in 74ms)
Dual search engine combining FTS5 BM25 keyword matching with local ONNX/FastEmbed semantic vector search

benchmarks.loadout_token_footprint: <300 tokens (168 tokens standard; 245 tokens under multi-rule diffs)
benchmarks.supersession_self_healing: 100% Pass@1 autonomous remediation in 1 turn across DeepSeek V4.1, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B, and Llama-3.1-8B
benchmarks.session_trajectory_gc_trr: 86.58% Token Reduction Ratio (16,830 tokens compacted to 2,259 tokens)
benchmarks.symbolic_offloading_trr: 99.44% token reduction on compiler and test runner stack traces
benchmarks.binary_footprint: 3.6 MB pure-Rust core binary; 19 MB macOS arm64 / 34 MB Linux x86_64 bundling fastembed + ONNX Runtime
benchmarks.cold_start_latency: 3.4 ms native startup, ~11.7 MB RAM footprint during execution
